claims.claim: Proportion is the size relationship between parts. Use comparative measurement: choose a reference unit, estimate other lengths relative to it, and check alignments. Perspective describes how spatial relationships appear from a viewpoint; distant equal-sized objects may appear smaller, and parallel lines receding in certain directions can appear to converge. Not every image follows linear perspective, and deliberate distortion may serve an artistic purpose.

locators.limitations: Not universal criteria for artistic worth
